scene.speaker: valentina
scene.bubble: Story time: the octopus who wanted to hug everyone! Eight arms, eight hugs at the same time.
scene.intro: Story time with Valentina: the octopus who wanted to hug everyone! He had eight arms and too much love, so the crab ran away, the starfish said no thank you and the jellyfish just floated past. In the end a friendly shell said yes, and they were friends for ever. Under the sea, between the waves, everything has a story. What lives under the sea?

data.voice_note: Voces: Valentina (cuentacuentos) y Mateo (efectos de sonido marinos).
data.script: Valentina: Once upon a time, deep under the sea, lived Otto the octopus. … Valentina: Otto had eight arms and one big dream: to hug every animal in the ocean. … Valentina: He hugged the crab — carefully, because of the claws. … Valentina: He hugged five starfish at the same time! … Valentina: But the jellyfish said: better a smile than a hug, dear Otto. … Valentina: And the shark? Otto waved at him… from far away. … Valentina: At the end, all the animals made a circle and hugged Otto together. … Mateo: Eight arms were not enough for so much love!
